stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The old theater is reportedly reopening next month.
items.sentenceZh: 据报道，这座老剧院将于下个月重新开放。
items.scene: A local reporter shares a blank illustrated news card about a closed old theater; above the building a translucent future version shows doors open, while a small question-shaped cloud conveys that the reopening is reported rather than witnessed or confirmed. Fully drawn adult faces and natural hands. No actual writing, calendars with numbers, real newspaper brands or logos.
items.altText: 记者传递老剧院可能重新开放的消息，画面以半透明未来景象表示尚未证实。

items.sentenceEn: The designers collaborate to build one shared prototype.
items.sentenceZh: 设计师们协作制作同一个原型。
items.scene: Three adult designers at one workbench each contribute a different necessary component to a single shared physical prototype, fitting the parts together rather than working on separate projects. Natural hands and expressive illustrated faces, no labels, writing or logos.
items.altText: 三名设计师在同一工作台协作组装一个原型。

items.sentenceEn: The well-known baker greeted customers at the market.
items.sentenceZh: 那位知名面包师在集市上向顾客打招呼。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese neighborhood market, a fictional adult baker behind a stall is warmly recognized by several returning customers, who wave and point out the baker to newcomers; handmade bread provides context. Fame is shown through community recognition, not a real celebrity. Natural varied faces and hands, no posters, writing or logos.
items.altText: 中国社区集市上，许多顾客认出一位广为人知的面包师并向其打招呼。

items.sentenceEn: The port supports commerce between nearby towns.
items.sentenceZh: 这座港口促进附近城镇之间的贸易。
items.scene: A contemporary Chinese river port and adjacent market show merchants exchanging crates of produce and manufactured goods arriving from two nearby towns by small cargo boats; goods and payment tokens move in opposite directions, emphasizing trade. Respectful natural adult faces and hands, no national flags, signs, writing, brands or logos.
items.altText: 中国河港集市里，商人把来自周边城镇的货物运来交换。

items.sentenceEn: The surrounding trees kept the small house cool.
items.sentenceZh: 周围的树木让这座小房子保持凉爽。
items.scene: An overhead three-quarter view centers one small house encircled on all sides by a ring of tall leafy trees; their shadows cover the roof and garden while exposed ground outside the ring is sunny. The spatial relationship of surrounding is unmistakable. No people, labels or writing.
items.altText: 一圈高树从四周围住小房子，为屋顶和庭院遮阳。

items.sentenceEn: The documentation shows how to assemble the device.
items.sentenceZh: 文档说明了如何组装这台设备。
items.scene: An adult technician uses an open ring-bound pictorial manual with a clear three-panel visual assembly sequence to build a small device on the workbench; each diagram corresponds to a real part in hand. The instructional document is central, with no readable text, pseudo-writing, numbers, codes or logos. Natural face and hands.
items.altText: 技术人员参照图示文档，按步骤组装设备。

items.sentenceEn: The park protects an ecological network of plants and animals.
items.sentenceZh: 这座公园保护了由植物和动物构成的生态网络。
items.scene: A protected wetland park in China shows native reeds, insects, fish, frogs and waterbirds linked through a believable shared habitat, with no species touching unnaturally; one distant boardwalk keeps visitors away from nesting areas. Emphasize interdependence in an ecosystem, not a single isolated animal. No signs, text, flags or logos.
items.altText: 中国湿地公园里，芦苇、昆虫、鱼、蛙和水鸟共同组成生态网络。

items.sentenceEn: The support agent will escalate the issue to a specialist.
items.sentenceZh: 客服人员会把这个问题升级交给专业人员处理。
items.scene: At a support desk, an adult agent passes one unresolved issue card upward through a clearly tiered workflow to a specialist with diagnostic tools; the customer's original device remains the shared focal problem. Show transfer to higher expertise, not an exploding conflict or stairs alone. Complete illustrated faces and natural hands, blank cards, no words, code or logos.
items.altText: 客服将未解决的问题沿分级流程转交专业人员。

items.sentenceEn: The small research outfit packed equipment for the field study.
items.sentenceZh: 这家小型研究机构为实地调查打包设备。
items.scene: A compact independent research outfit of four adult colleagues works in one modest shared workspace, packing labeled-by-color field sensors and notebooks into cases before heading outdoors; show the cohesive small organization and its equipment, not clothing fashion. Natural diverse illustrated faces and hands; no readable labels, text or logos.
items.altText: 小型研究机构的成员在共享工作室里整理野外调查设备。

items.sentenceEn: The new equipment was the team's largest expenditure.
items.sentenceZh: 新设备是团队最大的一笔开支。
items.scene: A workshop budget is represented by plain colored tokens: one clearly larger group of tokens moves from the team's budget tray to pay for a new machine, while two much smaller groups go to ordinary supplies. Make an outflow of money for a purchase and its relative size clear. No people, currency symbols, text, numbers or brand marks.
items.altText: 预算中最大一份资金用于购买新设备，小份资金用于其他用品。

items.sentenceEn: The region experienced unprecedented rainfall this season.
items.sentenceZh: 这个地区本季出现了前所未有的降雨量。
items.scene: A stylized weather observatory compares a row of several past seasons represented by modest filled rain jars with one current season jar towering far above every earlier level; a rain cloud and measuring vessel make rainfall clear without false numbers or real data. No disaster imagery, people, letters, statistics or labels.
items.altText: 本季降雨量的容器明显高于过去所有季节，显示前所未有的雨量。

items.sentenceEn: The columnist writes a weekly piece about city life.
items.sentenceZh: 这位专栏作家每周写一篇关于城市生活的文章。
items.scene: A fictional adult columnist in a contemporary Chinese newsroom drafts an article at a desk while several successive newspaper pages pinned nearby show the same dedicated vertical column area filled only with blank geometric blocks and small illustrations of city life. Repeated authored column, not a one-time reporter event. Complete natural face and hands, no actual writing, readable text, logos or brands.
items.altText: 中国新闻编辑室里，专栏作家持续撰写关于城市生活的固定栏目。

items.sentenceEn: Rent and electricity are part of the shop's overhead.
items.sentenceZh: 房租和电费属于店铺的日常运营开支。
items.scene: A small shop operates below two recurring expense symbols: a plain landlord building key silhouette and an electricity bulb; small budget tokens flow to them on each of several blank monthly cycle panels while products remain separate on shelves. Convey ongoing indirect operating cost, not overhead physical position alone. No people, money amounts, numbers, writing or logos.
items.altText: 店铺每个运营周期都要支付房租和电费等持续开支。

items.sentenceEn: They decided to postpone the outdoor meeting until the rain passed.
items.sentenceZh: 他们决定把户外会议推迟到雨停以后。
items.scene: One small outdoor meeting icon is lifted from a rainy earlier blank calendar square and moved along a clear arrow to a later sunlit square; the same group is shown under shelter waiting rather than canceling. Adults have natural illustrated faces and hands. No dates, words, letters or logos.
items.altText: 下雨时，户外会议从较早的日程格移到雨后的较晚日程格。

items.sentenceEn: Her morning workout includes stretching and light jogging.
items.sentenceZh: 她的晨练包括拉伸和慢跑。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese city park at dawn, one adult woman completes a gentle warm-up stretch beside a looping jogging path, with a small inset-like continuation showing her light jog; exercise is the focal repeated activity. Natural face, limbs and hands, safe footwear, no fitness metrics, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国城市公园清晨，女子先拉伸再沿步道慢跑。

items.sentenceEn: The preliminary sketch helped the team compare ideas.
items.sentenceZh: 初步草图帮助团队比较不同构想。
items.scene: At a design table, two rough simple early sketches of a chair sit alongside loose material samples while a more finished prototype remains only a pale distant silhouette, making this an exploratory first step before final design. Two adults compare the sketches with natural illustrated faces and hands. No annotations, readable writing, numbers or logos.
items.altText: 团队在设计初期比较两张粗略草图，尚未制作最终成品。

items.sentenceEn: The cashier gave her a receipt after the purchase.
items.sentenceZh: 付款后，收银员给了她一张收据。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese neighborhood cafe, a cashier hands an adult customer one narrow paper receipt emerging from a small register immediately after she pays for a cup of tea; the receipt contains only blank geometric blocks and a tiny cup icon, no lines resembling fake words or numbers. Natural faces and hands, no brand or logo.
items.altText: 中国社区咖啡馆里，顾客付款后从收银员手中接过一张收据。

items.sentenceEn: The illustrator holds the copyright to her original drawing.
items.sentenceZh: 这位插画师拥有自己原创画作的著作权。
items.scene: An adult illustrator creates one unmistakably original drawing at her desk; a protective translucent boundary links the artwork to its creator while a potential copy remains outside the boundary awaiting permission. Convey authorship and rights in a creative work, not ownership of an invention. Fully rendered face and hands, no copyright symbol, text, legal seals or logos.
items.altText: 插画师创作原画，画作与创作者之间的保护联系体现著作权。

items.sentenceEn: The engineer received a patent for the new valve.
items.sentenceZh: 工程师为这种新阀门获得了专利。
items.scene: An adult engineer holds a newly granted blank technical certificate beside a distinctive working valve prototype and matching exploded technical drawing; a neutral embossed seal indicates formal grant without depicting any real government agency. Emphasize protection of an invention, not artistic copyright. Natural hands and complete face, no readable text, letters, numbers, logos or official insignia.
items.altText: 工程师展示新阀门实物、设计图以及获批的专利文件。

items.sentenceEn: The unauthorized entry was a breach of security.
items.sentenceZh: 未经授权的闯入构成了一次安全防线突破。
items.scene: A protected data facility has a continuous access boundary with one visibly broken gate segment; an unrecognized silhouette is found just inside while an alarm light alerts staff on the outside. Show the violation of a protective boundary without operational details or glamorization. No readable interface, code, text, letters, logos or violence.
items.altText: 数据设施的防护入口被未经授权者突破，警报随之亮起。
